mostWorthwhile.text: The island sequence was most worthwhile: an initially bare volcanic island became home to life and eventually different songs, giving the journey a sense of consequence.

leastWorthwhile.text: The seasonal-journey intermediate felt predictable, especially as it was the only offered action, though it connected migration to the island.

surprise.text: Rocky world plus air producing axial tilt surprised me; the later seasons explanation clarified why tilt matters, but not why air created it.

arbitrary.text: Air's role felt unclear both in making the volcanic island and in producing different songs. The results explained the phenomena better than the chosen ingredients.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the prospect of seeing the world develop further on its own is appealing, despite some opaque combinations.
